about: Archive extraction check (plan G6/R6). Each case is a tar stream (base64), the profile it is read under and the verdict: {ok:true, entries, bytes} or {ok:false, code}. Profiles: 'volume' (an app's files folder: regular files, folders, symlinks and hard links that stay inside) and 'archive' (a server archive: regular files only). Default limits unless the case sets them. Rules, in order per entry: header (checksum, ustar/GNU magic, octal or base-256 size), GNU L/K and pax x (path, linkpath, size; GNU.sparse.* is a sparse file; g is unsupported), entry count, name (absolute, any '..', empty), kind (devices, FIFOs, sparse; the profile), duplicate and through-link, link targets (symlink resolved lexically from its folder, never through a link; hard link to an earlier regular file), declared sizes, then the data. Built by tools/archive-extraction-vectors.mjs.
